bug_description: spvBinaryToText crashes with SEGV when called with SPV_BINARY_TO_TEXT_OPTION_REORDER_BLOCKS or SPV_BINARY_TO_TEXT_OPTION_NESTED_INDENT on a malformed SPIR-V module that contains OpFunctionEnd with no preceding OpLabel. The crash occurs in OrderBlocks at disassemble.cpp:416 where cfg.blocks[0] is accessed on an empty std::vector. The disassembler's deferred-mode HandleInstruction defers per-instruction emission and drives a CFG state machine: each OpLabel pushes a SingleBlock onto current_function_cfg_.blocks, and each OpFunctionEnd calls EmitCFG(). When OpFunctionEnd appears without any preceding OpLabel, blocks is empty, and the unconditional subscript cfg.blocks[0].nest_level = 0 writes past the end of the vector (NULL-region write at offset 0x50). The crash is reachable through the public C API (spvContextCreate + spvBinaryToText) without any harness-internal state. Structural validation that would reject a function tail with no function head lives in the separate spvValidator pass and is not invoked by spvBinaryToText.
build_sh:
#!/bin/bash -eu
set -eu

cd /src/spirv-tools

# Build SPIRV-Tools static libraries with ASan via CMake
mkdir -p build
cd build
cmake -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug \
    -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=clang++ \
    -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=clang \
    -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS="-fsanitize=address -g -O1 -fno-omit-frame-pointer -stdlib=libc++" \
    -DCMAKE_C_FLAGS="-fsanitize=address -g -O1 -fno-omit-frame-pointer" \
    -DCMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS="-fsanitize=address" \
    -DSPIRV_SKIP_TESTS=ON \
    -DSPIRV_SKIP_EXECUTABLES=OFF \
    ..
cmake --build . -j$(nproc)
cd ..

# Build the harness against the ASan-instrumented libraries
clang++ -fsanitize=address -g -O1 -std=c++17 -fno-omit-frame-pointer -stdlib=libc++ \
    -I include -I external/spirv-headers/include \
    /src/harness.cc \
    -Wl,--start-group \
        build/source/libSPIRV-Tools.a \
    -Wl,--end-group \
    -pthread \
    -o /src/harness_bin
secb_sh:
#!/bin/bash

build() {
    echo "BUILDING THE PROJECT..."
    if /usr/local/bin/compile 1>/dev/null; then
        echo "BUILD COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY!"
    else
        echo "BUILD FAILED!"
        exit 1
    fi
}

repro() {
    echo "REPRODUCING THE ISSUE FOR spirv-tools.issue-6663..."
    /src/harness_bin /testcase/poc.bin
    # NOTE: YOU SHOULD NOT RETURN/EXIT 0 IN THIS FUNCTION.
}

patch() {
    echo "PATCHING THE PROJECT..."
    cd /src/spirv-tools
    if git apply /testcase/model_patch.diff; then
        echo "PATCH APPLIED SUCCESSFULLY!"
    else
        echo "PATCH APPLICATION FAILED!"
        exit 1
    fi
}

if [ "$#" -ge 1 ]; then
    command="$1"
    case "$command" in
        build) build "$@" ;;
        repro) repro "$@" ;;
        patch) patch "$@" ;;
        *) echo "Unknown command: $command"; echo "Usage: secb [build|repro|patch]"; exit 1 ;;
    esac
else
    echo "Usage: secb [build|repro|patch]"
    exit 1
fi
dockerfile:
FROM hwiwonlee/secb.base:latest
ENV FUZZING_LANGUAGE=c++
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y git cmake make
RUN git clone https://github.com/KhronosGroup/SPIRV-Tools.git spirv-tools \
    && cd spirv-tools \
    && git checkout ff5c50339cc1e9f34f04cb440a3e5fe89db0161d \
    && git clone https://github.com/KhronosGroup/SPIRV-Headers.git external/spirv-headers \
    && cd external/spirv-headers \
    && git checkout ad9184e76a66b1001c29db9b0a3e87f646c64de0 \
    && cd ../.. \
    && find . -name .git -type d -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true \
    && git init \
    && git config user.email "secbench@local" \
    && git config user.name "secbench" \
    && git add -A && git commit -m "spirv-tools at ff5c503 (pre-patch)"
WORKDIR $SRC/spirv-tools
COPY harness.cc $SRC/harness.cc
COPY build.sh $SRC/
RUN mkdir -p /testcase
COPY poc.bin /testcase/poc.bin

bug_report:
SEGV in OrderBlocks via empty CFG when OpFunctionEnd precedes any OpLabel

Component: spirv-tools/source/disassemble.cpp (OrderBlocks function, line 416)

When the disassembler is invoked with REORDER_BLOCKS or NESTED_INDENT, Disassembler::HandleInstruction defers per-instruction emission and drives a CFG state machine. Each OpLabel pushes a SingleBlock onto current_function_cfg_.blocks, and each OpFunctionEnd calls EmitCFG(). EmitCFG calls OrderBlocks, whose first statement unconditionally subscripts cfg.blocks[0].nest_level = 0 and cfg.blocks[0].nest_level_assigned = true.

When a malformed SPIR-V module emits OpFunctionEnd with no preceding OpLabel, cfg.blocks is empty. cfg.blocks[0] references past the end of the vector, and the write to .nest_level (at byte offset 0x50 inside SingleBlock) produces a SEGV to address 0x000000000050.

Call chain:
  spvBinaryToText -> spvBinaryParseWithOptions -> Parser::parse -> Parser::parseModule
  -> Parser::parseInstruction -> DisassembleInstruction -> Disassembler::HandleInstruction
  -> Disassembler::EmitCFG -> OrderBlocks (CRASH at line 416)

PoC: 24-byte SPIR-V binary with valid magic, no OpLabel/OpFunction, and an OpFunctionEnd (opcode 0x38) as the last word. Crash is deterministic and reproduces 3/3 times.

CWE: CWE-125 / CWE-787 (out-of-bounds access on empty vector)
Severity: Medium (CVSS 5.5) - reliable DoS against any tool disassembling untrusted SPIR-V with REORDER_BLOCKS or NESTED_INDENT (spirv-dis --nested-indent, IDE shader-debug pipelines, WebGPU/Vulkan tooling).
